description: This PHP source file is part of a network gateway web interface, responsible for displaying Wi-Fi status information including link status, MAC address, and system uptime for concurrent 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz Wi-Fi radios. It includes external PHP includes for headers, utility functions, navigation, and footer, and contains embedded HTML and JavaScript for rendering the web page.

methods.name: div_mod
methods.description: Performs integer division and modulus operation, returning quotient and remainder as an array.
